title.narrative: Migration Missing Links Afghanistan and Ethiopia

description.narrative:
Migration Missing Links (MML) is a pilot initiative implemented by Seefar Foundation in Afghanistan and Ethiopia. The programme aims to improve the effectiveness of development programming related to migration by strengthening how potential beneficiaries are identified and supported.
The project uses digital outreach and screening tools to identify individuals who may be considering irregular migration and who could benefit from existing livelihood or training programmes. Selected individuals receive counselling and are referred to partner initiatives providing employment, skills development, or entrepreneurship support.
Participants receive ongoing psychosocial counselling to help them remain engaged in these opportunities and improve their chances of successful economic outcomes. Through this approach, the project seeks to improve livelihood prospects for individuals who might otherwise undertake irregular migration journeys, while generating evidence on how targeted development programming can address migration drivers.
